AdminUpdateBeatBody.description: Admin-only immediate edit (R-BEAT-17) — applies without approval.
AdminUpdateBeatBody.title: AdminUpdateBeatBody

ApprovalSummaryResponse.description: Single source for every pending count on every surface (R-AP-30).
ApprovalSummaryResponse.title: ApprovalSummaryResponse

AttendanceTodayResponse.description:
The single canonical duty-state payload — S-ATT1 mount, the punch-in gate, and the body of
every successful `POST /attendance/punches` (M09 §5.1, §5.2).
AttendanceTodayResponse.title: AttendanceTodayResponse

CallsKpiWindowOut.description:
One drill level: the view root's own aggregate plus a row per direct reportee.

`totals` is the root's roll-up over every active sales person beneath it — not the sum of
`items`, which would count a manager and their own reportees twice over.
CallsKpiWindowOut.title: CallsKpiWindowOut

CaptureLeadBody.description:
S-LEAD1 — a salesperson captures a prospective business as a lead for follow-up. Leads are
for manufacturers not on Humbee, so they are named as free text — at least one — rather than
picked from the Humbee roster.
CaptureLeadBody.title: CaptureLeadBody

CombinedVisitFeedbackBody.description: S-CVIS2. `responses` absorbs the still-pending business schema as JSONB (R-RTE-33).
CombinedVisitFeedbackBody.title: CombinedVisitFeedbackBody

CompanyAddressBody.description:
Humbee requires none of the three lines. We require the first two, because an operational
address with one line is not deliverable; the third stays optional.
CompanyAddressBody.title: CompanyAddressBody

CoordinateCorrectionBody.description:
O-4 — a field pin correction captured during a visit, possibly offline.
The outlet is the visit's own outlet (from the path), never a client-supplied id.
CoordinateCorrectionBody.title: CoordinateCorrectionBody

CreateAdminBody.description: Bootstrap-only payload: role and hierarchy fields are intentionally fixed.
CreateAdminBody.title: CreateAdminBody

CreateBeatBody.description:
S-BEAT2 entry (transition #1). `id` is the client-generated ULID (idempotent create).
`owner_employee_id` lets an Admin/Manager create the beat for a salesperson; omitted, the
caller becomes the owner.
CreateBeatBody.title: CreateBeatBody

manufacturer_id.description: Humbee brand_id selected from the outlet sellers response; sent upstream as manufacturer_id.
manufacturer_id.title: Manufacturer Id

seller_id.title: Seller Id

CreateTargetBody.description: S-TGT1 save, for an employee and month that has no active target of this type yet.
CreateTargetBody.title: CreateTargetBody

DesignationScopeOut.description:
Which hierarchy level `targets` is rolled up to, and what else the caller may pick.
`targets` is always scoped to one designation level, never the whole tree, so a
manufacturer's target progress means the same thing before and after a filter change.
Every other field on `ManagerDashboardKpisResponse` (including `mom`) stays whole-tree.
DesignationScopeOut.title: DesignationScopeOut

DistrictLabel.description:
Districts also carry their state, since district names are not unique across states
(`PRATAPGARH` occurs in both UP and Rajasthan).
DistrictLabel.title: DistrictLabel

DocumentLookupResponse.description:
ON-1 — the registered address behind a GSTIN or PAN, for pre-filling the firm form.
Only `document_type` is guaranteed; other fields are optional.
DocumentLookupResponse.title: DocumentLookupResponse

FirmAddressDistrictsResponse.description: C-15 — the district step, always bounded by one state.
FirmAddressDistrictsResponse.title: FirmAddressDistrictsResponse

FirmAddressOptionsResponse.description:
C-16 — the locality and pincode steps. `location_id` and `pincode` are exactly the values
`OperationalAddressBody` takes, so a picked option is copied straight into the firm body.
Either list may legitimately be empty.
FirmAddressOptionsResponse.title: FirmAddressOptionsResponse

FirmAddressStatesResponse.description: C-14 — the state step of the firm address form.
FirmAddressStatesResponse.title: FirmAddressStatesResponse

GeoLabel.description:
`{id, name}` snapshot for a zone/state, taken at assignment time (epic 07 Story 7.2) — the
master cache that used to let a stored id resolve back to a name is gone.
GeoLabel.title: GeoLabel

GeoScope.description: Full replacement object. Omitted keys must not become `[]` and wipe stored scope.
GeoScope.title: GeoScope

LeavePreviewResponse.description:
The S-LV1 info card, server-authoritative (M12 §10). `exceeds_balance` drives the advisory
banner only — submission is never blocked on it (R-LV-11).
LeavePreviewResponse.title: LeavePreviewResponse

LeaveRequestItem.description:
One S-LV2 row. `approval_request_id` is what the Withdraw action posts to —
`POST /api/v1/approvals/{id}/withdraw` (M12 §4 S-LV2, §10 "Decisions — not here").
LeaveRequestItem.title: LeaveRequestItem

ManufacturerRosterResponse.description:
The roster behind a sales target's lines. Humbee owns it; SFA may
never create, rename or delete a manufacturer (R-TGT-04). `basis`/`uom_label` say whether that
manufacturer's line is entered in ₹ or units — the form has no separate basis choice.
ManufacturerRosterResponse.title: ManufacturerRosterResponse

MarkReadResponse.description:
`changed` is false when the row was already read — re-marking is a no-op `200`, never a
`409` (M06 §10).
MarkReadResponse.title: MarkReadResponse

OrderContextResponse.description:
S-ORD1 fan-out. `no_sellers_linked` and `seller_selection_required`
are first-class recovery states, not errors — when either is true the routing/PO/ship-to/
banner fields are empty and the client renders the recovery screen instead.
OrderContextResponse.title: OrderContextResponse

OutletInsightProfilerResponse.description: `url` is pre-authenticated and PII-bearing — never log or persist it.
OutletInsightProfilerResponse.title: OutletInsightProfilerResponse

OutletInsightSectionResponse.description:
One insight section. `data` is Humbee's display tree, passed through unchanged — the
figures are pre-formatted strings and phase 1 is placeholder, so SFA fixes no shape here.
OutletInsightSectionResponse.title: OutletInsightSectionResponse

PunchBody.description: `id` is the client-generated ULID for the `PunchEvent` (M09 §3.2, R-ATT-18).
PunchBody.title: PunchBody

ShopCategory.description: Stable Humbee shop-category identifiers used for filtering and persistence.
ShopCategory.title: ShopCategory

SpTargetsKpisResponse.description:

filter doesn't require re-running that endpoint's visit/call metrics.
SpTargetsKpisResponse.title: SpTargetsKpisResponse

SubmitLeaveBody.description:
S-LV1 submit. `id` is the client-generated ULID that makes a retried submit provably the
same request (M12 §3.1); `is_half_day` has no S-LV1 control in v1 (§12 Q4) and is not accepted.
SubmitLeaveBody.title: SubmitLeaveBody

TargetLineBody.description:
One manufacturer's share of a `sales` target.

The server snapshots the manufacturer's label/basis/UOM from the authoritative roster at write
time, so the body carries only identity and value.
TargetLineBody.title: TargetLineBody

TeamAttendanceResponse.description:
S-ATT3/S-ATT4 — one endpoint, scope resolved from the actor (R-ATT-17). Summary counts are
computed over the full scope, never the visible page (R-ATT-12).
TeamAttendanceResponse.title: TeamAttendanceResponse

TeamLeaveItem.description: One S-LV3 row. The avatar initials are derived client-side from `employee_name` (M12 §8).
TeamLeaveItem.title: TeamLeaveItem

TimelineStep.description:
§3a.5. `state` is one of `done` / `edited` / `current` / `rejected` — the four values the

TimelineStep.title: TimelineStep

UnreadCountResponse.description: `bellCount`. `0` means the client renders no badge at all, not "0" (M06 §8).
UnreadCountResponse.title: UnreadCountResponse

UpdateEmployeeBody.description: Every field optional — only supplied fields are applied.
UpdateEmployeeBody.title: UpdateEmployeeBody

UpdateTargetBody.description:
S-TGT1 save over an existing target. Employee, type and month are the target's identity
(R-TGT-08) and are not editable — changing one is a different target.
UpdateTargetBody.title: UpdateTargetBody

VisitOutcomeDetail.description:

recorded, including the orders placed, without growing `RouteStopItem` (read by every stop on

S-DASH-ADM: Admin org-wide dashboard.

`org_metrics` honours `period`. `targets`, `targets_summary`,
`manufacturer_movement`, `approval_latency`, and `mom` are always MTD;
`targets_summary` and `manufacturer_movement` always span every manufacturer.
`employee_progress` is always MTD; `designation_code` narrows it to one hierarchy
level and defaults to `all` (every level, ordered by level then name) — see
`designation_scope`.

S-DASH-MGR: Manager team dashboard.

`team_metrics` honours `period`. `scatter`, `districts`, and `mom` are always MTD and
whole-tree. `league` and `targets` are always MTD and scoped to one hierarchy level
(`designation_code`, defaulting to one level below the caller) — see `designation_scope`.

S-DASH-SP: Sales Person visit/call KPIs, honouring `period`.

Manufacturer-scoped target progress is a separate call — see
`/dashboards/sales-person/targets` — so switching manufacturer doesn't
re-run these queries.
S-DASH-SP: manufacturer-scoped target progress (always MTD).

One calls-KPI drill level (TC/PC/SC/UTC), today+MTD.

`for_employee_id` roots the level at that employee; omitted, it roots at the
caller (admin: the top-level managers). Rows are the root's direct reportees and
`totals` is the root's own roll-up. The activity timeline stays on `coverage`.
S-ROUTE1/3. A manager/admin may pass `employee_id` for S-ROUTE5's drill-down.
S-CVIS1's day picker (R-RTE-30).
